svg.title: Light Pollution Power BI Dashboard Preview
svg.desc: A dark-themed Power BI dashboard showing urban light pollution, sky quality metrics, wildlife impact, and dark sky initiative tracking across 13 global cities.
svg.text: Global City Night Sky Quality Dashboard | 2018–2023 | 13 Cities | 4 Datasets
Sky quality declining across all extreme cities
Projected improvement if cities reach target LED conversion %
Powered by DAX What-If parameter: LED_Conversion_Parm (0–100) | Adjust slider in Power BI to model scenarios
Bubble size = population | Color = pollution severity
Data Sources: Globe at Night (SQM), VIIRS Nighttime Lights, IDA Dark Sky Database, IUCN Wildlife Reports | Refresh: Annual
Built with Power BI Desktop | 4 CSV sources | 3 relationships | 45+ DAX measures | 1 What-If parameter
